messages:
alex: FYI PR #6820 CI failed on linux/x86 — snapshot mismatch in ui/Button.test.tsx. blocking merge until we decide whether to update snapshots or fix test.

chen: taking a look. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6820

maria: what was the failure? sometimes CI node has timezone diffs that flip snapshots.

alex: error excerpt: ```
● Button › renders primary

    expect(value).toMatchSnapshot()

    Received: "<button class=\"btn btn--primary\">Click</button>"
    Snapshot: "<button class=\"btn btn--primary  \">Click</button>"
```

sam: that looks like a trailing space in classname. small CSS change could cause it. if it's intended we should update snapshot, otherwise fix generator.

chen: I reproduced locally. `yarn test ui/Button.test.tsx` shows same mismatch. It's from a refactor that normalized classes; the extra space got removed. I can update snapshot with `yarn test -u`, but want a quick approval that UI hasn't regressed.

rachel: can you add a tiny screenshot to the PR showing the button render? quick check for spacing/line-height would be helpful.

chen: added screenshot and note. Will push snapshot update in ~15m.

maria: @devbot can we rerun CI after the snapshot update? fallback: if the previous failure was a flake we can rerun without updating.

devbot: CI status: linux-x86 failed (job 4821). To re-run: click "Re-run jobs" on GitHub Actions or use `gh` CLI.

alex: low risk — approve updating snapshot once screenshot exists. @sam any objection?

sam: no objection. lgtm for snapshot update.

chen: pushed commit `update(ui): refresh Button snapshot` and kicked off CI.

devbot: CI re-run started (job 4833) — triggered by chen.

devbot: CI passed on linux-x86, macos, windows. All checks green.

alex: thanks! merging in 10 minutes unless someone flags. :shipit:

rachel: quick a11y glance — still fine. lgtm.

alex: merged PR #6820. thanks everyone for fast reviews and rerun.

sam: noted: we should add a tiny unit util to trim classes to avoid whitespace-sensitive snapshots in future. filing a follow-up ticket.

alex: created follow-up issue #6890 to normalize classnames in snapshots — assigning to eng-runtime.

chen: great, thanks all.
